crossRefs.note: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.
From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed.
Hear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my cry come to you.
then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul;
When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for…
Yes, you would even cast lots for the fatherless, and make merchandise of your friend.
Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.
My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
Being in agony he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.

translations.web: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.
translations.bsb: My spirit grows faint within me; my heart is dismayed inside me.
translations.kjv: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.
translations.asv: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; My heart within me is desolate.
